SELECT  [FILE_NAME]
,[Date]
,[insert_dttm]
,[Metrics]
,[Source]
,[Target]
 FROM [d360].[LOG_TBL] 
 --where file_name like '%CRM%'
 order by 1,4

 SELECT  count(*), substring(file_name,7,3)  source
 FROM [d360].[LOG_TBL] 
group by  substring(file_name,7,3) 
 order by 2


select * from


WITH cte as (
select count(*) Count_tgt
,sum(cast(APY_PCNT as float)) APY_PCNT_tgt
,sum(cast(DPD_CNTR as float)) DPD_CNTR_tgt
,sum(cast(MATCH_OPP_RATE as float)) MATCH_OPP_RATE_tgt
,sum(cast(SECURITY_INDICATOR as float)) SECURITY_INDICATOR_tgt
,sum(cast(TS_CNT as float)) TS_CNT_tgt
,FILE_NAME
 from d360.STG_DEP_GAC where H = 'D' and FILE_NAME = 'CBC01_DEP_GAC_001_20220907.CSV'
group by FILE_NAME
),
 joint as
(
select
SUBSTRING(H,3,len(H)) Count_src
,APY_PCNT APY_PCNT_src
,DPD_CNTR DPD_CNTR_src
,MATCH_OPP_RATE MATCH_OPP_RATE_src
,SECURITY_INDICATOR SECURITY_INDICATOR_src
,TS_CNT TS_CNT_src
,b.*
from  d360.STG_DEP_GAC a
JOIN cte b on a.FILE_NAME = b.FILE_NAME
where a.H <> 'D' and a.FILE_NAME = 'CBC01_DEP_GAC_001_20220907.CSV'
)


-- Unpivot the table.  
SELECT File_name, Metrics
FROM   
   (SELECT * 
   FROM joint) p  
UNPIVOT  
   (Orders FOR Metrics IN   
      (Count_src, Count_tgt
      ,APY_PCNT_src
      ,APY_PCNT_tgt
      ,DPD_CNTR_src
      ,DPD_CNTR_tgt
      ,MATCH_OPP_RATE_src
      ,MATCH_OPP_RATE_tgt
      ,SECURITY_INDICATOR_src
      ,SECURITY_INDICATOR_tgt
      ,TS_CNT_src
      ,TS_CNT_tgt)  
)AS unpvt;
